# LDraw-derived minifigure mould attribution

The STL files in this directory are geometry conversions of official LDraw Parts Library parts and are used to build the production Lloyd (Tournament Robe) character.

Source library: https://www.ldraw.org/
STL conversion mirror used for the vendored files: https://github.com/ArjhanToteck/LDraw-Library

The current official LDraw headers for the parts used here report **CC BY 4.0**. The accompanying LICENSE file is retained in this directory.

| Vendored file | Original LDraw part | Description | Original author |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 61183.stl | 61183.dat | Minifig Hair Swept Back Tousled | Philippe Hurbain [Philo] |
| 15619.stl | 15619.dat | Minifig Bandana Ninja | Philippe Hurbain [Philo] |
| 3626b.stl | 3626b.dat | Minifig Head with Blocked Hollow Stud | Tore Eriksson [Tore_Eriksson] |
| 973.stl | 973.dat | Minifig Torso | Steve Bliss [sbliss] |
| 3815.stl | 3815.dat | Minifig Hips | Steve Bliss [sbliss] |
| 3816.stl | 3816.dat | Minifig Right Leg | Steve Bliss [sbliss] |
| 3817.stl | 3817.dat | Minifig Left Leg | Steve Bliss [sbliss] |
| 3818.stl | 3818.dat | Minifig Arm Right | Chris Dee [cwdee] |
| 3819.stl | 3819.dat | Minifig Arm Left | Chris Dee [cwdee] |
| 3820.stl | 3820.dat | Minifig Hand | Orion Pobursky [OrionP] |

The meshes are transformed, assembled, recolored and combined with original clean-room Tournament-robe decoration geometry by this project. Those project-specific modifications are identified in `scripts/generate-lloyd-exact-production.mjs`.
